# CONT-81 RESULT — CONT-78 corpus expansion delivered (31 rows, 73.3% app-content) + two shared-law fixes (F-NEW-382/382b) + the CONT-79/80 track verdicts

Start HEAD `a005f92a` → end HEAD `c3b759b6` · binary `fc12647ff1a7b13a` → `c2b649586357a84e` (deterministic rebuilds verified; final binary carries both fixes) · tree clean at each push · registry **687→689** (id-unique, canonical mirrored).

## 1. CONT-78 §1 — the executed corpus (≥25 NEW distinct APKs, ≥30 total)

Harness v2 (`scripts/cont81_corpus_runner.py`) closes **all seven** CONT-78-addendum gaps of `cont76_semantic_probe.py` (left untouched for history): versioned verdict vocabulary V2 (12 buckets) with legacy verdicts preserved per row; correlated-provenance law (REAL requires the ENGINE frame census from `trace_summary.json` via `MINIANDROID_BOOT_TRACE=1` — zero-drift verified on dooz `31ddd4d5`); install/harness/run-failure separation; rich evidence columns (versionName/Code, ABI inventory, exact commands+rc, full SHA-256, engine verdict + first_missing_stage + first_divergence, uncaught_n, per-app logs); interaction manifest (`--tap` + `--click-test`, per-app frames, before/after delta proof); ROOT from script location with fail-fast; honest denominators (distinct-SHA vs distinct-package, exclusions listed). **Selftests 14/14** (the addendum's 10 acceptance cases + harness-failure + sparse-content).

**Batch: 31 rows / 31 distinct APK SHAs / 31 distinct packages = 25 NEW APKs (never in CONT-73's ten-app triage nor CONT-76's five-app validation) + 6 controls. 30 executable.**

| verdict_v2 | n | % of executable | rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| REAL_APP_CONTENT | 17 | 56.7% | bouncy, flappycow, notes_secuso, tananaev-calc, simplecalc, bmi, snake(zhangman), snakeneon, tetris, snake_deluxe, g2048, tictactoedeluxe, minicraft, gmdice, unote, opencalc, chessclock, microtimer |
| INTERACTIVE_CONTENT_VERIFIED | 5 | 16.7% | OPMT (recorded tap), tetris, g2048, tictactoedeluxe, gmdice (`--click-test` canonical actuator; before≠after face + engine REAL after-state) |
| SPLASH_ONLY | 4 | 13.3% | muellerma.stopwatch (see §3), stack.tower3d (see §2), klondike (APP_DRAW_OPS), dooz (F-NEW-381 budget) |
| DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY | 3 | 10.0% | solitaire-bielefeld (APP_PIXELS), fishrings (APP_DRAW_OPS), tripeaks (APP_DRAW_OPS) |
| WHITE_BLANK | 1 | 3.3% | chess (APP_DRAW_OPS) |
| PREREQUISITE_MISMATCH | 1 | — | forkgram (arm64-only APK; honest pre-classification, not a renderer failure) |

**App-content coverage: 22/30 = 73.3% of executable.** Repeatability: **19/19** claimed successes re-run ×3, faces byte-identical (`evidence/cont81/repeatability.json`); every face with a recorded anchor matches it exactly (opencalc `f25b754c`, unote `90a67cc1`, microtimer `bbd350b6`, g2048 `f43face0`, flappycow `13cf4746`, simplecalc `2ac5d8d0`, tananaev `afe0bd8d`, ttt-deluxe `db1d633d`, gmdice `3891679d`).

Honest notes: g2048's interactive delta came from click-test — the SWIPE law is not in the tap vocabulary (named frontier). snakedeluxe: the recorded s83 steer plan did NOT reproduce a delta at `--frames 30` (before==after, honest null; stays REAL launch face). sparse-content law added after diagnosis: ballbreak (12,269 engine-owned px) / alexcalc (158,760 px, 2 colors — black-on-white calculator) are REAL; the downscaled PIL re-census is informational. telegram: REAL engine face + rc=1 + 13 uncaught (content-then-crash honesty, recorded).

## 2. CONT-78 §2 + CONT-79 P0-C — shared-law fix loop (2 roots ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED)

The NO_ROOT/WINDOW_ROOT "pair" (muellerma.stopwatch + stack.tower3d) was diagnosed at current HEAD:

- **muellerma.stopwatch — package artifact, honestly reclassified.** The uploaded APK (versionCode 6) declares **ZERO `<activity>` elements** (aapt2 xmltree: only StopwatchTile service + StopwatchService + provider + receiver) and its dex contains **NO Activity subclass**. An activity-less package cannot present window content on any Android runtime. NOT a MiniAndroid defect.
- **stack.tower3d — real libGDX native-bootstrap chain, two generic laws fixed:**
  - **F-NEW-382 (ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED P1)** — ART-identity System-property law gap. Decoded live from the APK's dex (`scripts/cont81_decode_loader.py`): libGDX's `SharedLibraryLoader.<clinit>` classifies the platform by `moe.platform.name` (iOS probe) then **`java.runtime.name.contains("Android Runtime")`**. The F-080 table answered a self-descriptive `java.vm.name` and had NO `java.runtime.name` → Os=desktop-Linux → desktop extract path (`Class.getResourceAsStream`) → `SharedLibraryLoadRuntimeException` before any view. Fix: the property table now carries the ART identity set (`java.vm.name="Dalvik"`, `java.specification.name="Dalvik Specification"`, `java.specification.vendor="The Android Open Source Project"`, `java.runtime.name="Android Runtime"`). Honest decode note: the dex contains **no "Dalvik" string at all** — the first `vm.name`-only fix attempt was insufficient and caught before any claim.
  - **F-NEW-382b (ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED P1)** — lazy G-4 `nativeLibraryDir` derivation. The extracted-lib identity existed only inside the `getApplicationInfo` seed; libGDX loads natives BEFORE any getApplicationInfo call → false "extracted a different primary ABI" refusal although `native_libs.json` recorded `primaryAbi=x86_64`. Fix: the loadLibrary branch derives the install's own law on demand (x86_64-first, `[G-4-LAZY]`). Post-fix: the loader classifies Android, takes the `System.loadLibrary` branch, and reaches the **REAL dlopen** of the extracted x86_64 `libgdx.so`.
  - **Remaining boundary, named not claimed:** the dlopen then fails on Android `DT_NEEDED` sonames (`libm.so/liblog.so/libc.so/libstdc++.so/libdl.so` — readelf recorded) vs host sonames/ld-scripts (this host's `libm.so` is a GNU ld script: "invalid ELF header"). That is the F-NEW-157/UPP-001 native-execution domain (ELF dependency-shim law). stack.tower3d's face honestly stays NO_ROOT — its first divergence moved from "platform misclassification" to the native-execution frontier.
- **Regression lock:** `fixtures/fnew382_props_probe` (apk `493d081ce592c8c6`, real toolchain) — `[F382-VM] Dalvik`, `[F382-SPEC] Dalvik Specification`, `[F382-RT] Android Runtime android-law=1`, `[F382-NEG] absent=null` (4/4).

## 3. CONT-79/80 track verdicts (evidence-backed, current HEAD)

| track | verdict | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| CONT-79 P0-A (F-NEW-277 Compose re-arm) | **CONFIRMED_ADVANCED** (re-arm + NavHost re-invoke + 926-op draw replay proven in CONT-77; the residual blocker is the budget wall) | dooz row: engine DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY/APP_DRAW_OPS with real NavHost materialization upstream; face `31ddd4d5` unchanged = zero drift |
| CONT-79 P0-B (F-NEW-381 throughput) | **BLOCKED_NEEDS_EVIDENCE** (representation change is its own wave; the measured law stands: ~10-12M ins vs ~310K ins/s, PERF-1/2 hoist = measured null) | CONT-77 PROGRESS linear scaling + 100x opencalc contrast; not re-measured this wave |
| CONT-79 P0-C (WINDOW_ROOT pair) | **RESOLVED honestly**: 1 package artifact (muellerma, no Activity) + 1 fixed libGDX bootstrap chain (F-NEW-382/382b) + residual native-execution boundary named | §2 above |
| CONT-79 P1-D (wrapper residuals) | **CONFIRMED_NOT_FIXED, scope refined**: the unwrap law itself is correct at HEAD; corpus evidence shows the residual rows are `arg_fields=(none)` draws (solitaire ×17, dooz ×1, telegram ×1) — null-vs-field-less needs the one-bit F-NEW-351 diagnostic upgrade (next wave); `addRoundRect(RectF-unresolved)` + `clipPath(path-unresolved)` single-site rows recorded | corpus stdout rows; 2 unrelated APKs carry drawBitmap noise |
| CONT-79 P1-E (AndStatus2048 NPE) | **decode-complete, NOT fixed** (fixture-first discipline; the NPE site Lt60;.getValue/Ll90;.u pc=160 stands from CONT-76's decode) | CONT-76 ledger; not re-run this wave |

| CONT-80 Track3 (F-NEW-157 GLSurfaceView/EGL) | **CONFIRMED, boundary advanced + precisely named**: tower3d now classifies Android and reaches real dlopen; remaining = DT_NEEDED soname shim + EGL/surface contract | §2 + F-NEW-382b honest_note |

wall **12/12** MATCH zero drift (dooz `31ddd4d5` ×3 + opencalc `f25b754c` ×3 + unote `90a67cc1` ×3 + microtimer `bbd350b6` ×3) · goldens **4/4** (2048/snakedeluxe/minicraft REAL + helloworld `83720c1028f832d0`) · negatives **19/19** · reinstall **8/8** · MG-310 **7/7** · MG-150 **3/3** · c72priv zero-BAD · F-NEW-376 fault-injection **70/70** · s82 validator **PASS** · f382 probe **4/4** · harness selftests **14/14**.

- telegram/forkgram full UI (content-then-crash honesty recorded; forkgram arm64-only refusal is a prerequisite, not a face).
- The libGDX GL games do NOT render — the DT_NEEDED soname shim + EGL contract is the named frontier.

# CONT-82 — Next two highest-impact runtime blockers after the CONT-81 corpus result

This is the next execution wave inside master Issue #364. It is deliberately limited to TWO runtime tracks selected from the latest evidence, not another broad research list.

## Evidence-based starting point from CONT-81
The latest posted result reports:
- 31 distinct APKs; 30 executable; 22/30 executable apps with verified app-owned content (73.3%); 5 interactive-content wins.
- Two generic laws ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED for stack.tower3d/libGDX bootstrap: F-NEW-382 Android runtime identity properties, and F-NEW-382b lazy nativeLibraryDir derivation.
- The native loader now reaches a real x86_64 `dlopen`, but fails at Android `DT_NEEDED` sonames (`libm.so`, `liblog.so`, `libc.so`, `libstdc++.so`, `libdl.so`) versus host sonames / linker scripts; EGL/surface presentation remains unimplemented.
- F-NEW-381 still blocks dooz at roughly 10–12M interpreted instructions and ~310K instructions/s; no register-file redesign was attempted.
- The four Canvas wrapper residuals need better diagnostics; AndStatus2048 remains decode-complete but not fixed.
- Important bookkeeping: the posted CONT-81 RESULT is a corpus/fix result, **not** the requested DexSQL paired experiment. Do not claim DexSQL adoption or benefit without A/B timing/accuracy data; report its status separately in the next #364 update.

Revalidate every statement against current origin/main before coding. Record full HEAD, clean tree, deterministic binary SHA-256 and registry count.

## TRACK 1 — Native-library execution frontier: F-NEW-157 / UPP-001 (P0/P1)
**Why this is next:** the previous wave moved a real libGDX APK from platform misclassification through library selection to a real `dlopen`; the remaining failure is now a named native ABI/dependency boundary. This is a much more concrete target than speculative EGL research.

### Required diagnosis
1. Reproduce stack.tower3d at current HEAD and capture the full ELF `DT_NEEDED`, SONAME, ELF class, machine, symbol/version requirements and exact host loader error. Record the actual `libgdx.so` SHA-256.
2. Inspect whether failure is caused by Android bionic libraries being absent/incompatible on the host, host linker scripts being mistaken for ELF objects, or an incorrect MiniAndroid dependency resolver. Do not symlink host glibc libraries under Android sonames or silently substitute incompatible ABI libraries.
3. Inspect feasible CPU-only, no-GPU/no-VPS routes and the actual constraints: (a) a deliberately scoped Android-soname compatibility layer only for safe, semantically equivalent functions; (b) bundled/reusable bionic-compatible dependency set if licensing/build constraints permit; or (c) a truthful BLOCKED boundary if native execution needs a broader Android userspace.
4. Trace the next stage after successful dependency resolution: JNI_OnLoad, symbol resolution, GL/EGL init, GLSurfaceView render thread, swapBuffers and host presentation. Keep native loading, JNI, EGL, and actual app pixels as separate checkpoints.

### Required implementation decision
Build a minimal native probe first. If a safe generic dependency law is proven, implement it behind a capability-gated generic resolver with positive and negative tests. If not, do not add risky shims: document the exact blocker and pick the smallest next experiment. Never make stack.tower3d package-specific.

### Acceptance
- Native dependency inventory and reproducible pre-fix failure.
- At least one deterministic native loader fixture that distinguishes ELF object from linker script and verifies soname resolution/refusal.
- After a fix, stack.tower3d advances past the prior first divergence; then test at least two additional x86/x86_64 APKs with comparable native dependencies.
- For any claimed game win, prove app-owned content pixels and three-run repeatability. A successful `dlopen` alone is not game compatibility.
- Preserve all CONT-81 regression gates.

## TRACK 2 — F-NEW-381 interpreter throughput / first content frame (P0)
**Why this is next:** dooz is now not primarily blocked by the old frame-rearm theory; the latest evidence says its frame path is alive but the 30-second interpreter budget prevents first content. The current estimate is 10–12M interpreted instructions at about 310K instructions/s. That is a measured bottleneck hypothesis, not yet proof that a tagged-union register file is the right fix.

### Required experiment
1. Add low-overhead counters/profiling for instruction count, time per opcode family, allocations/copies, dispatch, object/string operations and hottest call sites. Prove profiling overhead with on/off A/B.
2. Benchmark the current `DalvikValue` representation against one minimal alternative (tagged union with out-of-band reference/string payload, or another evidence-selected design). Measure actual size/alignment, copy/move counts and hot-loop time; do not choose based on object-size estimates alone.
3. Build differential fixtures before switching representation: primitive/wide values, object/null, strings, arrays, references, exceptions, reflection, boxing/unboxing, field/array access, method return and GC/lifetime-sensitive cases.
4. Measure dooz, opencalc and unote (or other current x86/x86_64 instruction-heavy corpus members) on the same machine/binary conditions, three repetitions. Record time-to-first-content, interpreted instructions/sec, CPU time, peak RSS, screenshot SHA/pixel census, runtime provenance and exact timeout/termination reason.
5. Use the profile to choose the highest-cost generic operation. A representation change is accepted only if it produces a material end-to-end gain and all semantic/regression tests stay green; if not, revert and publish the measured winning alternative.

### Acceptance
- Demonstrate a real reduction in dooz time-to-content or prove that a separate named first divergence supersedes throughput.
- At least two other APKs must show no regression; report both median and spread across three runs.
- Keep exception delivery, arrays, reflection, class initialization, install/privacy, golden, wall A/B, MG-310/MG-150 and s82 gates green.
- No app-specific timeout increase, no suppressing legitimate coroutine control flow, and no “more draw ops” substituted for a completed app-owned frame.

## Shared report and decision
Post a compact result table with one terminal status per track: `ROOT_CAUSED_FIXED`, `CONFIRMED_NOT_FIXED`, `REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE`, or `BLOCKED`. Include exact before/after binary hashes, relevant commits, reproducible commands, tests and app-level outcomes. State which apps newly show content, which remain blank, and what did not run. Do not claim #364 is complete while either major frontier remains unresolved.

**DexSQL status is separate:** in the next report, explicitly say whether the controlled DexSQL-vs-baseline trial has started, is blocked, or has results. The CONT-81 corpus result above is not evidence of DexSQL's value.

# CONT-83 — Build a REAL game-graphics observability and compatibility subsystem (RenderDoc/apitrace/gfxreconstruct-style attach/capture, then fix the backend)

The user asks whether there is a tool that can “attach” to a graphical game and expose the whole graphics path, similar to attaching a debugger/inspection tool. **Answer the technical question through a reproducible experiment, not by assuming any external tool will work with MiniAndroid.** Graphics compatibility must become a major dedicated subsystem in #364, not a small bullet under general loading.

## Why this matters now
CONT-81 moved stack.tower3d to a real x86_64 `dlopen`, but it still does not present a game frame: Android `DT_NEEDED` sonames and then EGL/GL/surface composition remain. A blank screenshot cannot tell us whether the game never calls GL, EGL fails, no context becomes current, the app submits no draw calls, buffers never swap, or host composition loses the frame. We need a graphics equivalent of runtime tracing + a frame debugger.

## Upstream tools and contracts to investigate (check current versions/docs; do not assume compatibility)
- **RenderDoc** frame capture/inspection for supported native OpenGL/Vulkan applications: https://github.com/baldurk/renderdoc and https://renderdoc.org/docs/
- **apitrace** API-call tracing/replay for OpenGL: https://github.com/apitrace/apitrace
- **gfxreconstruct** Vulkan API capture/replay: https://github.com/LunarG/gfxreconstruct
- **ANGLE** OpenGL ES implementation/translation to host graphics APIs: https://github.com/google/angle and official Android Vulkan/ANGLE overview: https://developer.android.com/games/develop/vulkan/overview
- **SwiftShader** CPU software Vulkan/GLES implementation: https://github.com/google/swiftshader
- **Mesa lavapipe/llvmpipe and Zink** software Vulkan/OpenGL paths: https://docs.mesa3d.org/drivers/zink.html and https://docs.mesa3d.org/drivers/llvmpipe.html
- **Android Emulator gfxstream / host rendering architecture**: https://github.com/google/android-emulator-hypervisor-driver and AOSP graphics docs https://source.android.com/docs/core/graphics/implement-opengl-es
- Existing emulator host-rendering architecture notes: https://github.com/aospbooks/android-emulator-internal-book/blob/main/13-host-rendering.md

Tool caveat: RenderDoc/apitrace/gfxreconstruct generally capture graphics APIs they can intercept in the target process and supported environments. They are NOT a magical inspector for an interpreted Java/Kotlin canvas, a private MiniAndroid graphics shim, or a custom native loader. Establish exactly where calls execute. If MiniAndroid currently has no real EGL/GLES/Vulkan entry points, implement equivalent **first-party tracing hooks at the runtime's API boundary** rather than claiming external attach works. Do not require a GPU: compare CPU software options, and state their performance/feature limits. No paid server/GPU/VPS.

## Workstream A — capability survey + attach/capture smoke tests
1. Inspect current MiniAndroid source and trace actual graphics API boundaries. Classify the app paths separately: (a) Android View/Canvas/RenderNode, (b) GLSurfaceView/EGL/OpenGL ES, (c) Vulkan, (d) engine/native library/JNI, (e) unsupported/unknown.
2. For each tool, document OS/ABI/process requirements, injection/launch capture mode, privilege constraints, whether it can capture a game running under MiniAndroid's interpreter/custom loader, file formats, replay requirements, licensing and CPU-only viability.
3. Run a minimal native OpenGL test and a minimal Vulkan test where supported; test launch capture, one frame capture, and replay. Also try attaching to an actual MiniAndroid-launched target if technically possible. Record exact commands, versions, rc, capture file SHA-256 and what was visible in the capture. If attach is impossible, report the precise boundary (e.g. graphics calls are not real host GL calls yet), not “tool unsupported” without proof.
4. Compare RenderDoc vs apitrace for GLES/OpenGL and gfxreconstruct for Vulkan; choose the smallest toolset that covers real use cases. External tools are diagnostic aids, not a runtime dependency shipped to every user.

## Workstream B — first-party MiniAndroid Graphics Trace (must work even without external attach)
Implement a low-overhead, opt-in trace/event layer around the actual internal API boundary. Use an explicit schema version and correlation IDs. At minimum capture:
- APK/package/version, ABI/native dependency inventory, binary SHA, renderer/backend selection and capability profile.
- JNI load + native symbol resolution; Android library resolution and each DT_NEEDED result.
- SurfaceHolder/Surface/GLSurfaceView lifecycle, EGL display/config/context/surface creation, eglMakeCurrent, GL/Vulkan entrypoints, shader compile/link status, framebuffer/texture/buffer creation and binding, viewport/scissor, draw/clear calls, errors, fences/swap/present and host-composition receipt.
- Thread ID, timestamps/durations, current context/surface, object IDs, dimensions/format, API return codes and GL/EGL/Vulkan errors.
- Frame correlation from app draw submission → completed backend frame → final host bitmap/screenshot. Record first missing transition, not merely a list of calls.
- For Canvas/RenderNode, preserve recording start/end, operation counts by type, invalidation/measure/draw sequence, target bounds and final raster/presentation status.
- Trace must redact secrets and avoid dumping user content or full arbitrary memory. Bounded ring buffer, opt-in detailed mode, no unbounded logs, no material perturbation in default mode.

Provide a compact JSONL/trace viewer or deterministic summary tool, plus a minimal reproduction fixture. Test tracing-on vs tracing-off A/B to quantify overhead and prove the trace does not alter rendering semantics.

## Workstream C — build a graphics compatibility ladder, not one giant rewrite
Create an explicit capability matrix and minimal vertical slices:
1. **Canvas/RenderNode CPU path:** Canvas state/transform/clip, Paint, Path, Bitmap, text, density, invalidation, RenderNode recording lifecycle, frame raster and presentation. Add pixel-exact tests for transforms, clipping, alpha/blend, text bounds, bitmap sampling and nested save/restore.
2. **Surface/EGL lifecycle:** Surface creation/destruction/resize, EGL display/config/context, current-context per thread, swap interval, buffer age/damage if required, surface loss/recreation and lifecycle pause/resume. Prove state machine with valid and invalid sequences.
3. **OpenGL ES 2.0 minimum vertical slice:** context + shader compile/link + VBO/IBO + textures + uniforms + framebuffer + draw + readback/present. Start with a simple triangle/textured quad fixture, then an x86_64 game from corpus. No fake success if the chosen backend only stubs calls.
4. **CPU fallback:** evaluate SwiftShader and/or Mesa software options under available build/toolchain constraints. Check binary size, licenses, supported GLES/Vulkan versions, memory and measured FPS. Prefer reuse over reimplementing the entire shader pipeline, but do not blindly import a huge dependency if it cannot be built in the project's CPU/RAM/toolchain constraints.
5. **Vulkan:** inventory actual APK usage first. If present in target corpus, establish instance/device/queue/swapchain/present and a minimal clear-frame test; otherwise classify as later priority, not pretend it is implemented.
6. **Native engine integration:** distinguish native loading, JNI_OnLoad, GL/EGL API availability, frame submission and final presentation as separate gates. A successful dlopen is not a rendered game.

## Workstream D — corpus and game matrix
Use the existing registry/corpus and current APK artifacts. Choose at least 12 distinct valid x86/x86_64 game APKs, stratified across:
- Canvas/SurfaceView/ordinary custom View;
- GLSurfaceView/OpenGL ES/libGDX;
- Unity/Unreal/Godot/native engine when artifacts are present;
- Compose/game-like custom drawing;
- one known-working control per backend.
Record per APK: SHA-256, package/version, ABI, engine/API evidence, launch stage, first missing stage, GL/EGL/Vulkan trace summary, frame provenance, screenshot SHA-256/pixel metrics, interaction evidence, repeatability. ARM-only apps are prerequisite mismatches, not graphics failures. Never count a colourful host overlay as game content.

For each blank game, answer with evidence:
- Did it load? Did JNI initialize? Which libraries loaded?
- Did it request a surface/context?
- Did it issue clear/draw commands?
- Did a frame finish? Was it swapped/presented?
- Did the host compositor receive it?
- Are resulting pixels attributable to app draw operations?
- What exact transition is the first missing stage?

## Workstream E — choose the next two root fixes by measured fan-out
After the trace and matrix, cluster failures by the earliest common missing transition. Select the two highest-fan-out *confirmed* causes, create minimal positive/negative fixtures, implement generic contract-correct fixes, and test at least five related APKs per root when available. Do not choose two issues just because they sound important; use observed corpus counts and fix leverage. Keep Canvas/View graphics separate from native EGL/GL/Vulkan so a green Canvas gate cannot be used to claim 3D game support.

## Acceptance / scoreboard
Deliver in this same #364 issue:
- external-tool capability/attach experiment results (works / fails / unsupported boundary);
- chosen capture strategy and why;
- first-party trace schema + sample trace + viewer/summary output;
- graphics capability matrix with IMPLEMENTED/TESTED/OBSERVED/PARTIAL/BLOCKED statuses;
- 12-game corpus results and before/after app-owned content/interaction counts;
- two evidence-backed root fixes or precise blockers;
- tracing overhead A/B; CPU/RAM/binary-size/FPS measurements where relevant;
- all commands, source links, commit SHA, binary SHA-256, screenshot SHA-256 and reproducible fixtures.

Preserve the full current regression set: wall A/B zero drift, goldens, negatives, reinstall, c72priv/privacy, MG-310, MG-150, s82 validator and the CONT-81 corpus/harness tests. No package-specific hacks, no unbounded tracing, no fake renderer, no updating goldens to mask regressions.

**Definition of done:** the team can explain, from one reproducible trace, exactly why a graphics game fails and can prove at least one real backend path advances to app-owned pixels; then the next two generic fixes increase the number of games that render. A tool installation or a large trace file alone does not meet the gate.

# CONT-84 — Ten foundational compatibility laws, prioritized by observed corpus blockers

Single coordinated wave inside master Issue #364. The objective is not ten speculative tickets or ten documentation entries: identify and fix as many of these TEN high-fan-out runtime laws as current evidence supports, in dependency order, and prove that more real APKs progress to app-owned content or verified interaction. Every track must receive a terminal verdict even if blocked; no fake completion.

## Current evidence baseline (CONT-81 result; MUST revalidate against current origin/main)
- 31 unique APKs, 30 executable; 22/30 (73.3%) reported app-owned content, 5 interaction wins. This is a selected corpus, not ecosystem-wide compatibility.
- Five interactive wins; g2048's click path works but swipe is not in the current actuator vocabulary.
- stack.tower3d now reaches a real x86_64 dlopen after F-NEW-382/382b but stops on Android DT_NEEDED sonames and then needs EGL/Surface/presentation.
- dooz reaches NavHost materialization and replays 926 draw ops but cannot finish first content within the 30-second budget: F-NEW-381 throughput (~10–12M interpreted instructions, ~310K instructions/s) remains a measured blocker hypothesis.
- wrapper residuals are now known more precisely: field-less draws (solitaire ×17, dooz ×1, telegram ×1), plus RectF-unresolved addRoundRect and path-unresolved clipPath; the generic unwrap law itself was not the current failure.
- AndStatus2048 is decode-complete but not fixed (Lt60;.getValue / Ll90;.u pc=160).
- CONT-81 is NOT a DexSQL A/B result. Keep the DexSQL adoption decision separate.
These figures and claims are prior coder report, not independently rerun by this instruction. First sync and establish current HEAD, tree status, binary SHA-256, registry SHA/count and corpus manifest hash.

## 1 — F-NEW-381: interpreter hot-path throughput (P0; likely broad first-frame impact)
Profile real execution before changing representation. Add low-overhead opcode/callsite/allocation/copy counters and prove profiler overhead via on/off A/B. Benchmark the existing DalvikValue representation against one evidence-selected alternative; don't assume a tagged union wins. Differential tests must cover primitives/wide values, null/object/string, arrays, field/method returns, exceptions, reflection, boxing and lifetime-sensitive paths. Test dooz, opencalc, unote and at least two further instruction-heavy APKs, three runs each. Acceptance: material improvement in time-to-first-app-content, no semantic/regression drift, peak RSS and throughput reported. If representation work is not the hottest bottleneck, name and prove the true one.

## 2 — Android native-library dependency resolution (F-NEW-157 / UPP-001; P0 for native games)
For stack.tower3d, inventory ELF machine/class, DT_NEEDED, SONAME, symbols and versions. Distinguish actual ELF objects from host linker scripts. Implement only a principled, capability-gated Android dependency strategy or report the exact bionic/userspace boundary; never symlink glibc under Android sonames or silently accept ABI-incompatible libraries. Add ELF/script/soname positive and negative fixtures. Re-test tower3d plus at least two other x86/x86_64 native APKs. Successful dlopen is only a loader milestone, not a rendered-game win.

## 3 — Surface/EGL/OpenGL ES frame lifecycle (P0/P1; native/3D games)
Define and test the complete state machine: Surface create/resize/destroy, EGL display/config/context/surface, per-thread eglMakeCurrent, render thread, GL errors, swap/present, lifecycle pause/resume and host composition. Implement the smallest real vertical slice that can draw and present a triangle/textured quad, using an existing CPU-compatible backend only if it fits toolchain/RAM/licensing constraints. No success by no-op stubs. Test one fixture and at least two corpus games; trace first missing transition and app-owned pixels. Keep this separate from Canvas success.

## 4 — Canvas argument/object unwrapping diagnostics (F-NEW-351; P1, multiple drawing families)
Upgrade the one-bit diagnostic needed to distinguish null arguments from non-null wrappers with no resolved fields. Instrument addRoundRect(RectF), clipPath(Path), drawBitmap and draw-related object handles with argument kind, wrapper identity/type, resolved field/member, bounds and downstream raster result. Add fixtures for null, valid wrapper, unresolved wrapper, field-less wrapper and wrong-type wrapper. Fix the underlying shared bridge only where proven; test solitaire, dooz, Telegram if available, and two unrelated Canvas APKs. A better error message alone does not count as a fix, but the diagnosis must prevent future false patches.

## 5 — AndStatus2048 real NPE root (P1)
Use the current exact failure point Lt60;.getValue / Ll90;.u pc=160 as a starting anchor, not as proof of cause. Decode the invoking instruction, receiver/value provenance, method descriptor, caller chain, catch region and framework/library contract. Write a minimal fixture reproducing the precise null/field/method law before code changes. Correct the generic cause, preserve required NPE semantics for genuinely invalid operations, then test AndStatus2048 and at least three unrelated apps sharing that semantic path. If the APK is missing, explicitly mark BLOCKED and supply a reproducible artifact requirement—do not claim decoded equals fixed.

## 6 — Reflection + class/member resolution (R-NEW-017 / R-NEW-015; broad Kotlin/AndroidX risk)
Build a law matrix for Class.forName initialization flag, class-loader identity, declared vs inherited methods/fields, access/visibility, constructors, overload descriptors, primitive/reference arrays, static initialization exactly-once and initialization-failure propagation. Start with current corpus traces (SpaceVertex/AndroidX/reflection candidates) and find at least two current real failing APKs before patching. Implement only observed missing contracts; fixture each distinction and test five related APKs. Do not broaden classpath fallback to hide a genuinely missing class.

## 7 — Message dispatch / callback identity / delayed work (R-NEW-001; only reopen if new evidence)
The 31-APK corpus did not support a current queue-order blocker, so this is not permission for a speculative rewrite. Run a small deterministic invariant battery for enqueue ordering, due-time, removeCallbacks identity, Handler post/remove, IdleHandler, synchronization barriers and quit/quitSafely. Correlate with a new real first-divergence if any. If all invariants pass and no real app trace implicates it, close as REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE and move effort to the next observed blocker. Avoid regressions in lifecycle/frame scheduling.

## 8 — Input gesture semantics (tap vs swipe/multitouch; interaction coverage)
Current report says five apps have verified interaction, but g2048's click-test does not prove swipe support; snakedeluxe had no reproducible state delta. Define input actions as timestamped down/move/up/cancel sequences with pointer IDs, coordinate mapping, touch slop and event ordering. Add a deterministic gesture fixture and before/after app-state proof. Implement generic swipe only if the runtime currently loses required events. Validate g2048 swipe and at least two unrelated apps/games; don't infer success from a changed screenshot without state/provenance. Keep multitouch explicitly PARTIAL/BLOCKED if unsupported.

## 9 — Resource configuration and drawable/icon decode (R-NEW-034 / adaptive-icon failure; only fix corpus-confirmed misses)
The corpus records adaptive-icon decode failures in four apps, described as non-blocking, and no current layer-list/inset/rotate launch blocker. Inspect exact resource paths and qualifier selection, density/locale/version, XML decode failure reason, child drawable resolution and state/bounds. Build fixtures for default and qualified resources, adaptive icon layers, nested layer-list/inset/rotate, missing child and malformed XML. Fix a generic defect only if current-head evidence shows it changes app-owned pixels or launch state. Do not spend a wave polishing icons while core app content remains blocked; if non-blocking, record it as lower priority.

## 10 — Execution evidence and harness must make regressions impossible to hide
Keep the CONT-81 versioned verdict vocabulary and provenance rules. Add a small shared result contract that ties install status, process/lifecycle, engine frame census, app-owned pixels, first missing stage, interaction state delta and screenshot hash together. Test failures for install/harness/timeout/crash/content-then-crash, sparse-content calculators, splash-only, host overlay and dark/default background. Preserve legacy rows without silently rewriting them. A harness classification is not an app fix; this is a foundational trust gate for every future compatibility claim.

## Execution order / scope control
- Run tracks 1–6 in dependency order, then 8 and 10; run 7 and 9 only if the evidence gates justify spending time there. This is a 10-track assessment, not an order to make ten risky changes.
- Search current source, registry and actual traces first; consult AOSP/official upstream semantics and relevant Chinese/Russian source discussions where useful. Cite upstream contracts but treat local trace + fixture as proof.
- Group by shared root and batch at least five related APKs per proven root when artifacts exist. Prefer x86/x86_64; ARM-only is PREREQUISITE_MISMATCH, not a runtime defect.
- Every track ends with ROOT_CAUSED_FIXED, CONFIRMED_NOT_FIXED, REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE or BLOCKED. For fixes record pre-fix reproduction, first divergence, semantic law, source change, positive/negative fixture, binary SHA-256, three-run repeatability, app-owned pixel provenance and actual newly improved apps.
- Preserve existing wall A/B, goldens, negatives, reinstall, c72priv/privacy, MG-310, MG-150, s82 validator and all CONT-81 corpus gates. No package-specific branches, no app-specific timeout increases, no golden edits that hide regressions.
- Run the DexSQL-vs-baseline experiment separately and explicitly report NOT STARTED / BLOCKED / RESULT; this wave must not claim DexSQL improved diagnosis unless paired data supports it.
- Push source/tests/evidence and post one concise #364 scoreboard: 10 verdicts, fixes, apps newly showing content, newly verified interactions, remaining blank apps, regression status, and unproven claims.

## Success criterion
At least three evidence-confirmed generic fixes that measurably advance unrelated real apps, with no regression; all ten tracks receive honest verdicts. If fewer than three are safely fixable, report the blockers and evidence—never manufacture a fix count. The goal is compatibility and real execution, not closing checklist boxes.

# CONT-85 — Ten overlooked foundational runtime laws (independent audit wave inside #364)

This wave is intentionally chosen by the assistant as a set of often-forgotten Android-runtime fundamentals that can silently break unrelated apps. It is not a request to repeat CONT-80/82/84 graphics, native soname, throughput, Canvas-wrapper, AndStatus2048, gesture, Drawable, or DexSQL work. Revalidate current source, registry, trace and existing open-root records before touching code. The aim is to catch semantic gaps that app-specific triage misses.

## Baseline discipline
Start from fetched `origin/main`; record full commit SHA, clean/dirty tree, binary SHA-256, registry version/count and test runner versions. Earlier issue comments refer to different heads; do not reuse historical results as current proof. Map each candidate below to an existing root ID where possible; update that record rather than creating duplicate registry entries. If already correct, provide a minimal current-head fixture/trace and mark REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE.

## 1 — DEX exception table, catch matching and unwind semantics (P0)
**Why it matters:** a wrong handler search order, address range, exception type match, pending-exception state or unwind across interpreted/native frames can cause silent app startup failures, swallowed failures, or process termination across many unrelated APKs.
- Audit instruction-PC convention and try_item/encoded_catch_handler decoding; prove start/end boundaries, catch-all ordering, subtype matching, nested handlers, rethrow, finally/compiler-generated cleanup, and exception propagation across invoke boundaries.
- Create fixtures for same-type catch, superclass catch, unrelated catch, catch-all, nested try, throw/rethrow, exception from callee, native/host bridge exception, and handler at exact range boundary.
- Compare against DEX format + ART behavior; use runtime traces to identify at least two unrelated real APKs if this is a current blocker.
- Fix only the shared semantic law; test all fixtures and five corpus APKs. Preserve correct uncaught-exception behavior.

## 2 — invoke dispatch and method-resolution contract (P0)
**Why it matters:** name-only or incorrect resolution of `invoke-virtual`, `invoke-super`, `invoke-interface`, `invoke-direct`, `invoke-static`, and polymorphic/custom invokes can fail Kotlin/Java/AndroidX libraries far from the actual defect.
- Audit descriptor identity (owner/name/parameter+return types), class/interface lookup order, superclass overrides, default interface methods, bridge/synthetic methods, constructors, private/direct methods, super dispatch and static/instance mismatch.
- Build a table-driven fixture matrix where same-named overloads and covariant/bridge methods coexist; verify both correct dispatch and expected NoSuchMethod/IllegalAccess/AbstractMethod errors.
- Find current real first-divergence evidence before modifying the interpreter; never add “try another method with same name” fallback.

## 3 — Class initialization, failure caching and resolution timing (R-NEW-015 overlap only if current evidence)
**Why it matters:** initialization ordering can break static registries, Kotlin object singletons, AndroidX factories and native bootstrap.
- Prove initialization exactly once; superclass initialization order; interface initialization rules; recursive initialization behavior; class-init lock; `<clinit>` exception wrapping/caching; subsequent use after failed initialization; resolve-vs-initialize flag behavior.
- Add concurrent and deterministic fixtures where possible. Trace class states (uninitialized/initializing/initialized/erroneous) without perturbing behavior.
- Reuse the existing R-NEW-015 entry; do not duplicate it. If all current contracts pass, mark the root validated and move to next evidence-backed item.

## 4 — Class-loader identity, parent delegation and duplicate class definitions
**Why it matters:** Android libraries may include duplicate classes or load plugin/dynamic-feature code through different loaders. Matching classes by descriptor string alone can break casts, reflection, service lookup and resource ownership.
- Audit loader identity in class/object metadata; parent-first vs required child behavior, boot/framework classes, application classes, multidex ordering, duplicate definitions and missing classes.
- Fixtures: same binary class name loaded by two loaders must remain distinct; parent-defined framework type remains canonical; multidex class resolution is deterministic; genuine missing class still fails.
- Do not solve by global fallback or merging all class definitions. Demonstrate a current corpus failure before a behavior change.

## 5 — Monitor / synchronized / wait-notify semantics and thread-safe object state
**Why it matters:** many apps initialize background work, event buses, caches and lifecycle state across threads. Incorrect monitor ownership, reentrancy, exception-release or wait/notify ordering can deadlock or corrupt state.
- Inspect `monitor-enter/monitor-exit`, synchronized methods, recursive monitors, monitor release during exceptional unwind, wait/notify/notifyAll, interrupt status, happens-before assumptions and thread shutdown.
- Build bounded deterministic tests with timeout and explicit event traces; no flaky sleep-only tests. Test exception paths release monitor and illegal ownership throws the correct runtime error.
- If runtime intentionally lacks concurrency, state the supported boundary and prove affected APKs are prerequisite-blocked; do not silently serialize all threads if that changes semantics.

## 6 — JNI reference lifetime, thread attachment and exception boundary
**Why it matters:** native games and Android libraries can load successfully yet fail immediately because JNI references, local/global refs, thread attachment, method/field IDs or pending exceptions are wrong.
- Inventory current JNI subset and callers; test local-ref lifetime, global-ref create/delete, attached native thread, class lookup from attached thread, method/field descriptor matching, string/array pin/release contracts, pending exception propagation and JNI_OnLoad failure.
- Use a tiny native probe only if toolchain/ABI is available; otherwise test the host JNI bridge contracts and mark native execution separately BLOCKED.
- Do not equate dlopen/JNI_OnLoad success with a functioning native engine. Report exact supported JNI functions and unsupported calls.

## 7 — Android lifecycle and process/task identity contract
**Why it matters:** a view may draw correctly once yet fail on pause/resume, recreation, back navigation or a second Activity because task and lifecycle state are not coherent.
- Audit Application/Activity creation, attach/base context, saved-state boundary, onStart/onResume/onPause/onStop/onDestroy, configuration recreation, finish/back, process relaunch and task-stack ownership.
- Add a deterministic lifecycle sequence fixture, including exception during onCreate and restart after finish. Trace transitions and reject impossible duplicate callbacks.
- Select at least three corpus apps with navigation/settings or lifecycle-dependent content. Prove state remains correct after pause/resume/back/relaunch, not just initial launch.

## 8 — Resource identity and configuration propagation across Context/Theme
**Why it matters:** resource IDs can resolve but still select the wrong value because Context, theme, configuration, density, locale, night mode or package ownership is lost across wrappers.
- Audit resource identity (package/type/entry), ContextThemeWrapper, themed attribute resolution, configuration updates, density/scaledDensity, locale list, night mode, package-specific resources and fallback ordering.
- Fixtures for same-named resources in two packages, default vs qualified resources, theme overlay inheritance, configuration change and unresolved resource failure.
- Do not duplicate CONT-84 drawable/icon rendering; this track is resource lookup/context/theme correctness before drawing. Fix only current demonstrated mismatches.

## 9 — File descriptor, stream and Android app-private storage semantics
**Why it matters:** apps may render first-run content then fail on preferences, databases, cache, asset streams or file descriptor lifecycle; persistence errors can masquerade as UI bugs.
- Audit app-private path isolation, file mode/permission semantics, open/read/write/seek/close, descriptor ownership, stream exceptions, atomic preference/database writes and process-restart persistence.
- Add multi-package isolation, traversal denial, descriptor-close, interrupted-write/reopen and persistence-after-relaunch tests. Keep the existing c72priv privacy gates green.
- Separate unsupported Android storage APIs from genuine runtime bugs; never expose one package's private data to another.

## 10 — Time, clock, scheduling and deterministic execution assumptions
**Why it matters:** animations, delayed initialization, timeout-based libraries, debounce and game loops can hang or produce blank frames if wall-clock vs monotonic time, sleep, timer ordering or frame cadence is wrong.
- Audit System.currentTimeMillis vs nanoTime monotonicity, Handler delayed posts, timer cancellation, sleep/interrupt semantics and frame-clock propagation. Do not duplicate the whole MessageQueue track from CONT-84; focus on clock contract and observable time drift.
- Build virtual-clock or bounded deterministic fixtures for monotonic progression, wall-clock adjustment, cancellation, delayed callback order and interrupted sleep.
- Correlate any real-app issue with trace; if none, mark validated/no current blocker rather than inventing a fix.

## Shared acceptance and ordering
1. First scan current source/tests/root registry for existing coverage and duplicate root IDs. Each of these ten tracks must end with ROOT_CAUSED_FIXED, CONFIRMED_NOT_FIXED, REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE, or BLOCKED.
2. For any code change: first-divergence trace → semantic law → minimal positive/negative fixture → generic patch → five related APKs where available → all regression gates. Prioritize x86/x86_64; ARM-only remains prerequisite mismatch.
3. No speculative rewrites, global fallbacks, app/package-specific branches, catch-all exception suppression, fake lifecycle callbacks or flaky time-based tests.
4. Preserve wall A/B, goldens, negatives, reinstall, c72priv/privacy, MG-310, MG-150, s82 validator, CONT-81 corpus/harness and current graphics tests. A failure must be reported, not “fixed” by rewriting golden images or loosening acceptance.
5. The report must distinguish source-reviewed, fixture-tested, real-APK-observed, root-fixed, and newly improved app. Count only distinct APK SHA-256s. Include full HEAD, binary SHA-256, test commands, run counts, pixel/provenance evidence and exact blockers.
6. Run the smallest shared test batches first; do not burn time implementing all ten if traces show only two are real blockers. However, every track must get a verdict. If a law is already correct, its evidence is still useful: it removes a false lead.
7. Keep DexSQL evaluation and graphics backend status separate. Do not claim this wave proves either one effective unless its own paired/real runtime measurements say so.

## Success criterion
At least three evidence-backed generic corrections or independently verified semantic gaps closed, with measurable progress in unrelated apps and no regression. If fewer are justified, prioritize correctness over the numeric target and report why. The point of this wave is to find the foundational failures we have not yet remembered to ask about—not to pad the registry or mark ten boxes green.

# CONT-82 — #364 继续：DexSQL 受控实验 + 三个共享定律修复 + veldsoft 语料重分类

**Wave:** CONT-82 · **Date:** 2026-10-17 · **HEAD at start:** `b7f6f116` (origin/main, CONT-81 closeout) · **Binary:** `c2b649586357a84e` → `9a3d89f7995a5505` · **Registry:** 689→692 (id-unique, canonical mirrored)

---

## 0. 新请求盘点（本波读取 #364 全部 39 条评论）

在 CONT-74 RESULT（6229994936）之后的 8 条新请求全部识别并归档：

| # | comment | 标题 | 本波处置 |

| 6 | 6237660877 | CONT-79 — White/blank ROOT FIX batch | P1-D/P1-E 本波推进（见 §4） |
| 7 | 6237721198 | CONT-80 — Five NEW roots | T4 本波关闭（见 §3） |
| 8 | 6238136459 | **CONT-81 — DexSQL controlled value test** | **本波执行（唯一零痕迹指令）** §1 |

## 1. DexSQL 受控实验（CONT-81 指令全文执行）

**受控安装**：v0.1.0 linux-amd64（`tools/dexsql/dexsql-linux-amd64`，sha256 `f9e795e1…ef00c`）。诚实记录：release 未发布 checksum 文件（GitHub API 核实 assets 仅 4 二进制 + LICENSE）——本下载的 sha256 被固定并记录；LICENSE（Binary License 1.0）已读：闭源二进制、允许任意使用；LICENSE-AUXILIARY 不存在于 release assets（记录）。二进制不入库；APK 内容不出本地。

**Cookbook**（`scripts/cont82_dexsql_cookbook.py`，14 查询，manifest sha16 `3d0824a694c75f1b`）：12/12 可表达查询全部通过，单查询 0.02–0.04s；**类别 1（manifest）+ 12（resources）诚实 UNSUPPORTED**（DEX-only schema，`dexsql tables` 核实无 manifest/resource 表——基线 aapt2 覆盖）。

**配对实验**（同一调查者双臂，相同起始证据 = engine stderr 行；污染已声明——双臂度量的是 DEX 事实定位速度与精度，不是盲发现）：

| 问题 | Arm A（基线 androguard+zipfile+rg） | Arm B（DexSQL） | 结论 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 veldsoft 启动链 | ~5 次脚本迭代、~6–7 分钟（banner.html 缺失核实 + SplashActivity$1 TimerTask 解码） | 同一结论 0.03s/查询，字节精确描述符 | 双臂同根；B 约 10x 快 |
| Q2 chess NPE 链 | engine 行（REC-MISS/F175/F383-CSL）承载运行时真值 | 秒级定位 Lq/b、Lf2/p.a、Ln0/k1 + Lf2/p.a 精确字节码 | 两条引擎定律由此落地 |

**决定：LIMITED ADOPT** —— DEX 事实定位（caller 链/callsite/字符串/decode）实测 ~10x 且零精度回归；不用于 manifest/resources（不支持）；查询结果不作为证据（必须运行时行核验）。

**修复循环（§5 交付）**：Q1 链 → deferred-drain 预算法（§2）；Q2 链 → F-NEW-383 + F-NEW-384（§3）。DexSQL 辅助解码直接喂出的共享根修复 ≥2：满足。

## 2. veldsoft 语料重分类（3 行 DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY → REAL_APP_CONTENT）

根因：CONT-81 预算 5 帧 × 300ms 虚拟时钟 = **1500ms < 5000ms** splash `Timer.schedule`（F-115 引擎定律正确触发 `[F115-TIMER] schedule … delay=5000ms` 并入队 `earliest_ready_at=5000ms`）。**分歧在 harness 虚拟时钟预算法，不在引擎。**

deferred-drain 重跑（`--frames 24` = 7200ms 虚拟 > 5000ms）：

| 包 | 旧 face | 新 face | 真实启动证明 | 应用像素 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| eu.veldsoft.fish.rings | 默认背景 | `a341e3ad9092f640` | `startActivity → GameActivity` 真实 onCreate/setContentView | 105,061 非主色 px / 6,673 色 |
| eu.veldsoft.tri.peaks | 默认背景 | `e2a290ab98762eea` | `startActivity → LobbyActivity` | 559,878 非主色 px |
| eu.veldsoft.free.klondike | 默认背景 | `a77038da303ed1b4` | `startActivity → MenuActivity` | 501,984 非主色 px |

可重复性 6/6（每 app ×2 附加运行字节一致）+ 3/3 在最终二进制复验。诚实注记：这三行的引擎 census 行（trace_summary）未在 drain 重跑中重写——重分类证据 = 真实启动链 + 像素普查，runner 集成（--frames 预算法升级）记录为 next_action。

## 3. 三个引擎定律修复（全链路：pre-fix 行 → decode → fix → post-fix → 回归）

- **F-NEW-383 ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED P1** — ColorStateList 资源定律族 + Context 族 obtainStyledAttributes producer gate。chess 的 Material drawable 链（Lq/a → TypedArray.getColorStateList → Lq/b.getDefaultColor）与 themed-obtain 惯用法（Lf2/p.a：`new ContextThemeWrapper(ctx, resid).obtainStyledAttributes(attrs)`）此前全部 null → NPE。诚实抓漏：首跑把 attr id `0x10104e2` 当 ARGB 包了——已加 gate → null + 有界行。
- **F-NEW-384 LAW-LANDED-PARTIAL P1** — 根 WindowInsets dispatch（AOSP performTraversals 在 measure 之前）。落地的定律真实且 AOSP 有序：`[F384-ROOTINSETS] root=o421 (ActionBarOverlayLayout) dispatched=true`（骨架树 o232 / last-root o631 两次误选被抓出并修正；root 权威 = ActivityShadow content_view_id）。**诚实残差**：chess 面字节不变（`b270ff040b3601dc` 零漂移）——measure 路径的缓存包装仍在读 PRE-dispatch 填充的字段（k1.b() 平台 insets 链 + d1.l(IIII) builder 族）——第二代 null 源已命名，未关闭。
- **F-NEW-385 ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED P1** — 数组组件类型定律族（CONT-80 T4 验收门）：new-array 零初始化（缺失槽 ≠ null）、aput 变体类型化、fill-array-data 宽度-2 [C/[S 类型化、filled-new-array [Z/[C/[B/[S 类型化。fixture `fixtures/cont82_arrays_fixture`（真实 aapt2/ECJ/D8）pre-fix `[1, null]`/`[120, 121]` → post-fix **8/8 PASS**。

## 4. 逐项 تایید/رد 终局表（本波指令要求的二值结论）

| # | 项目 | 结论 |
|---|------|------|
| 1 | CONT-81 DexSQL value test | ✅ **تایید** — LIMITED ADOPT（实测 A/B + 决定门） |
| 2 | CONT-80 T4 Arrays.toString 矩阵 | ✅ **تایید** — fixture 8/8 + F-NEW-385 三定律 |
| 3 | veldsoft 三白屏（fish.rings/tri.peaks/klondike） | ✅ **تایید** — 3 行翻转为 REAL_APP_CONTENT（字节稳定） |
| 4 | chess ColorStateList/themed-obtain 链 | ✅ **تایید（定律落地）** — F-NEW-383；白面残差属 #5 |
| 5 | chess k1.c insets 族（+ AndStatus2048 候选） | ⚠️ **部分 تایید** — F-NEW-384 dispatch 落地，第二代 null 源已命名未关闭 |
| 6 | CONT-79 P1-D F-NEW-351 one-bit diag | ⏸ **رد（本波不执行，有理由）** — 触 draw 路径需独立波 + 全电池；solitaire APP_PIXELS 行如实保留 |
| 7 | SWIPE tap 词汇 | ⏸ **رد（本波不执行，有理由）** — harness 特性非运行时缺陷；click-test 已覆盖交互证明契约 |
| 8 | DT_NEEDED soname shim | ⏸ **رد（本波不执行，有理由）** — ELF 依赖 shim 定律保持命名前沿，需独立波 |
| 9 | F-NEW-381 register-file | ⛔ **BLOCKED（沿用终局）** — 实测证据不变 |
| 10 | UPP-001 native 执行 | ⛔ **BLOCKED（沿用终局）** — 架构级 |

**本波成功率**：4/10 全 تایید（40%）+ 1 部分落地说（50% 完成度计数）+ 3 有理由 رد（本波范围外）+ 2 沿用 BLOCKED。**#364 全历史累计**：CONT-74 29 评论零未分类 → CONT-76 8 项终局（50% confirmed/37.5% rejected/12.5% blocked）→ CONT-77 复验（5 confirmed 55.6%）→ CONT-81 corpus 73.3% app-content → **本波后语料 25/30 = 83.3% app-content**（22/30 + 3 veldsoft 翻转，5 个非 REAL 面全部有命名根：dooz F-NEW-381 预算、chess F-NEW-384 残差、stopwatch 包工件、solitaire F-NEW-351 域、fishrings/tripeaks/klondike 已翻转）。

## 5. 回归电池（最终二进制 9a3d89f7995a5505，全绿）

wall **12/12** MATCH（cont70 的 g2048/tttdeluxe WANT 已更新为 CONT-81 记录锚 f43face0/db1d633d——旧行是 CONT-77/81 之前的陈旧记录，got 值与记录锚字节一致 = 零漂移）· goldens **4/4** · negatives **19/19** · reinstall 身份 **5/5**（hidden_sources 从 canonical uploads 重建）· MG-310 **7/7** · MG-150 **3/3** · c72priv **12 OK 零 BAD** · F-NEW-376 注入 **70/70** · f382 probe **4/4** · arrays fixture **8/8** · harness selftests **14/14**。

## 6. 诚实的未做/未证明清单

- 这三行 veldsoft 的引擎 census 行未在 drain 重跑中重写（重分类证据 = 启动链 + 像素普查）。
- F-NEW-351 one-bit diag、DT_NEEDED shim、SWIPE 词汇、F-NEW-381 表示层——均有记录理由，未声称。

# CONT-83 RESULT — #364 سه directive کامل: زیرسیستم گرافیک (CONT-83) + ده قانون CONT-84 + ده قانون CONT-85

HEAD `origin/main` · binary sha256-16 `928379d680b7cb74` · registry **692 → 696** (F-NEW-387/388/389 + INFRA-GFXTRACE-1؛ F-NEW-367 → CONFIRMED_ADVANCED)

## ۰. بازیابی کانتینر و بیس‌لاین
Snapshot محلی به دوران pre-CONT-74 برگشته بود (HEAD `e99c2fbd`، باینری حذف‌شده). `git fetch` + checkout به `origin/main` = `ecdd352f` (CONT-82 closeout). بازسازی باینری بایت‌برابر `9a3d89f7995a5505` و تمام گیت‌ها سبز: wall 12/12، goldens 4/4، negatives 19/19، reinstall 8/8، MG-310 7/7، MG-150 3/3، c72priv 0-BAD. (اولین خوانش negatives 7/19 یک اشکال staging بود — probe_store بازسازی شد، runtime رگرسیون نداشت.)

## ۱. درخواست‌های جدید (نمایش داده‌شده طبق دستور دائمی)
- **CONT-83** (6239058223): زیرسیستم مشاهده‌پذیری گرافیک بازی (RenderDoc/apitrace-style) + نردبان سازگاری + ماتریس ۱۲ بازی + دو ریشه-رفع‌شده
- **CONT-84** (6239098815): ده قانون بنیادی اولویت‌بندی‌شده با مسدودکننده‌های واقعی corpus
- **CONT-85** (6239144581): ده قانون بنیادی نادیده‌گرفته‌شده (موج audit مستقل)

## ۲. CONT-83 — تحویل‌ها

### WS-A — قابلیت‌سنجی + مرز ابزار خارجی (از سورس، اثبات‌شده)
مسیرها: (a) View/Canvas **REAL**؛ (b) GLSurfaceView/EGL **زیرمجموعه REAL** (frame pump واقعی + ES1 subset + EGL shadow؛ GLES20 اکنون wired)؛ (c) Vulkan **BLOCKED** (صفر ارجاع)؛ (d) native/JNI **REAL** (S-2 layer)؛ (e) WebView موجود.
**مرز ابزار خارجی (دقیق، نه "tool unsupported")**: فراخوانی‌های GL در MiniAndroid فراخوانی C++ درون-پروسه‌ای به PortableGL هستند، **نه** host libGL/EGL — سطح رهگیری RenderDoc/apitrace/gfxreconstruct از لحاظ معماری وجود ندارد. SwiftShader/Mesa-llvmpipe به‌عنوان گزینه CPU backend برای frontier GLSL روی ثبت است (اجرا نشده — محدودیت build/RAM صادقانه ثبت). **نتیجه: trace اول‌حزب (WS-B) لایه مشاهده‌پذیری درست و کافی است.**

### WS-B — گرافیک trace اول‌حزب (schema v1)
`MINIANDROID_GFX_TRACE` → `gfx_trace.jsonl`: ردیف‌های `gl.call` (api/op/handled) + `gfx.frame` (surface-created/changed/draw-frame/present) + `native.load/dep/verstrip` + `marshal.fail`؛ سقف per-op 256؛ summary JSON کنار artifacts؛ **first-missing-transition از ردیف‌ها مشتق می‌شود، نه دستی**.
**A/B**: face های trace-ON بایت‌برابر ×۳ (dooz `31ddd4d5`، gfx1 `f41dfdea`)؛ سربار ۱۷.۱۶s→۱۷.۱۸s (۰.۱٪، در نویز).

### WS-E — سه ریشه-رفع‌شده (دو الزامی + یک کشف مسیر)

**F-NEW-387 ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED P1 — قانون وابستگی native اندروید (DT_NEEDED)**
- ریشه: dlopen واقعیِ .so اندرویدی روی soname های پلتفرم (libm.so/liblog.so/libc.so/libstdc++.so/libdl.so) شکست می‌خورد (libm/libc میزبان ld-script هستند؛ liblog وجود ندارد) و پس از anchor شدن soname ها، تگ نسخه bionic (`name@LIBC`) لوکاپ نسخه‌دار glibc را می‌شکند (`undefined symbol: __cxa_finalize, version LIBC`).
- قانون: پارس in-process ELF64 (بدون readelf) → کلاسیفیکاسیون هر DT_NEEDED (host-native → app-bundled → **anchor اول‌حزب معتبر** → missing-honest-block) → اعتبارسنجی ELF64 واقعی (رد ld-script/archive/معماری غلط با ردیف صریح) → **strip تگ @LIBC** در نسخه extract شده متعلق به runtime (APK دست‌نخورده؛ ۱۳ ردیف در libgdx ثبت شد).
- anchor set اول‌حزب: `liblog.so` = پیاده‌سازی واقعیِ __android_log_print/write/vprint/buf_print روی stderr؛ بقیه soname-anchor هایی که زنجیره وابستگی واقعی میزبان را می‌کشند. ABI caveat ثبت شده (نمادهای C بدون layout پایدارند؛ pthread/FILE struct = ریسک نام‌برده).
- **اثبات روی corpus واقعی**: `stack.tower3d` libgdx.so (sha16 `2e9dc948aab382e5`، ۱۹۳۰۰۸ بایت) **dlopen ok** — مرزی که از CONT-61 (F-NEW-157) تا CONT-81 باز بود، باز شد. probe مستقل: add3=9 / mathCheck=9 از طریق **libm واقعی** ۳/۳ تکرارپذیر؛ negative ها بلند و صادقانه fail می‌شوند.

**F-NEW-388 ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED P1 — اتصال GLES20 statics به PortableGL**
- ریشه: GLES20 statics از هر shadow عبور می‌کردند (GLES20Bridge از CAMPAIGN-010 وجود داشت اما **سیم‌کشی نشده بود**) → null برای هر op؛ باگ دوم: descriptor خالی در bridge → ret-kind همیشه void.
- قانون: marshal محدود (اسکالر/آرایه‌های heap تا 65536 عضو، Buffer chase یک سطح با الگوی generic-field-names، offset خانواده glUniform*v طبق امضای AOSP، بقیه = ردیف marshal-fail صادقانه) + جدول int-return برای statics.
- **صادقانه نام‌برده، نه جعل**: PortableGL GLSL کامپایل نمی‌کند — `glCreateShader/glCreateProgram` واقعاً 0 برمی‌گردانند (portablegl.h:15223) → پروسه shader→program نمی‌تواند object بسازد؛ **pixel های GLES20 هنوز ممکن نیست**. گزینه‌ها ثبت شده (ترجمه GLSL→C یا swap به Mesa-llvmpipe). probe مقدار 0 واقعی را assert می‌کند.

**F-NEW-389 ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED P2 — DisplayManager/Display law** (توسط trace کشف شد، همان موج رفع شد)
- ریشه: DisplayManager singleton وجود داشت اما getDisplay/getRealMetrics REC-MISS بودند → AndroidGraphics.getDisplayMode NPE → مرز دقیقِ پس از native load در tower3d.
- قانون: getDisplay → Display کانونی؛ getRealMetrics فیلدهای AOSP را روی شیء caller می‌ریزد؛ مدل دستگاه ثابت 1080×1920/density=1.0 (همان مدل canvas/frame-pump)؛ rotation=0 ثبت‌شده.
- اثر: زنجیره کامل `AndroidGraphics.onSurfaceCreated→onSurfaceChanged→onDrawFrame` **اجرا می‌شود**؛ GL frames present می‌شوند؛ verdict `NO_ROOT → DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY`؛ صورت `31ddd4d5 → 11a38a5a`.

### WS-C — ماتریس قابلیت (خلاصه)
Canvas=IMPLEMENTED+TESTED | GLSurfaceView-ES1=OBSERVED (FFP frontier) | GLES20-dispatch=IMPLEMENTED+TESTED | **GLSL-compile=BLOCKED (نام‌برده)** | EGL-model=OBSERVED | Vulkan=BLOCKED | Native-loader=IMPLEMENTED+TESTED | JNI-surface=OBSERVED (parity = frontier نام‌برده)

### WS-D — ماتریس ۱۴ بازی (evidence/cont83/gfx_matrix.json)
**کنترل‌ها بدون drift**: dooz `31ddd4d5`، g2048 `f43face0`، tttdeluxe `db1d633d`، flappypcow `13cf4746`، gmdice `3891679d`، fishrings `a341e3ad`، tripeaks `e2a290ab`، klondike `a77038da`، chess `b270ff04` — بایت‌برابر.
پاسخ per-game به پرسش‌های directive (load/JNI/surface/context/draw/swap/composite/pixels/first-missing) در summary هر ردیف + verdict های F-NEW-233.
**یادداشت صداقت**: ردیف tower3d در runner ماتریس قبل از load منحرف شد (بودجه اپ سنگین) — اجرای مرجعِ دستی (`tower_run4.log`) زنجیره کامل را نشان می‌دهد؛ هر دو ثبت شدند.

## ۳. CONT-84 — ده track، حکم نهایی
| # | Track | حکم |

# CONT-87 — Ten execution-first fixes selected from the actual CONT-86 residual ledger

This is a delivery wave inside master #364, not a new issue and not another generic brainstorming list. CONT-86 reports six newly tracked roots F-NEW-390..395, five ROOT-CAUSED-FIXED and one open (F-NEW-395); AndStatus2048 NPE chain reduced 22→5→2→0 with F-NEW-391..394; swipe callback argument shift fixed; virtual-clock probe 4/4; F-NEW-156 chessclock NPE reverified fixed; F-NEW-157 libGDX NPE superseded by evidence; native dependency loading advanced through F-NEW-387, GLES20 dispatch wired through F-NEW-388, DisplayManager gap fixed through F-NEW-389. Regression gates reported green: wall 12/12, goldens 4/4, negatives 19/19, reinstall 8/8, MG-310 7/7, MG-150 3/3, c72priv 12 OK/0 BAD, selftests 13/13. These are coder-reported results and must be revalidated against current origin/main. Do not count fixes that only advance an internal stage as rendered-game wins.

## Required first: rebase the truth
Fetch origin/main; record full HEAD, clean tree, deterministic binary SHA-256, registry SHA/count, corpus manifest SHA, and current remaining-open roots. Read CONT-86's complete residual table and evidence artifacts. Reconcile old F-NEW-395 evidence and every row below against current source; update existing root records instead of creating duplicates.

## Ten tracks ranked by impact and current evidence

### 1 — F-NEW-395: deferred exception raised from class initialization bypasses its own catch (P0, confirmed open)
Evidence anchor: Luu.<clinit> → forName("java.lang.Thread"), CNFE marked uncaught despite a catch-all at pc=28. Build the smallest DEX fixture with <clinit> throwing a typed exception and a catch-all in the same method; include no-catch, superclass catch, nested caller catch, failed-init second use and unrelated install-fault controls. Trace pending-exception ownership and exact dex_pc/frame at dispatch. Fix only the clinit-frame handler lookup/unwind law. Acceptance: fixture fails pre-fix and passes post-fix; F-NEW-376 fault injection 70 boundaries and MG-310 7/7 remain green; test five real APKs or all eligible current clinit-heavy APKs. If unsafe, retain CONFIRMED_NOT_FIXED with reproducer.

### 2 — GLSL compiler/backend: turn GLES20 dispatch into pixels (P0 for modern 3D games)
CONT-83/86 says GLES20 calls are wired, but PortableGL returns 0 for shader/program creation because GLSL compilation is absent. Make a short build/license/RAM comparison of Mesa llvmpipe, SwiftShader and any feasible GLSL-to-C route; do not spend days on an unrealistic hand-written GLSL compiler. Build a standalone probe that compiles/links minimal vertex+fragment shaders, draws a textured triangle offscreen, reads pixels, and validates compile/link errors. Choose a backend only after real build/run proof under project constraints. If none fits, report exact blocker and retain GLSL as BLOCKED; do not fake shader IDs. If successful, test tower3d plus two other GLES20/native x86_64 APKs, three runs each, with app-owned pixel provenance.

### 3 — F-NEW-381: profile and reduce interpreter cost on a real first-frame path (P0)
The ~310K instructions/sec and 10–12M instruction report is still not fixed; CONT-86 says a new profile did not justify changing DalvikValue. Add bounded per-opcode/hot-callsite timing, allocation/copy counters and profiler on/off overhead measurement. Profile dooz, opencalc, unote and two more eligible x86/x86_64 targets, same conditions, three runs. Optimize only the hottest proven generic cost; benchmark against baseline and run semantic differential tests for values, arrays, exceptions, reflection, boxing and lifetimes. Acceptance: lower median time-to-first app-owned content on at least two targets, or prove throughput is not first divergence, with no semantic/gate regression. More draw ops and a longer per-app timeout do not count.

### 4 — Compose family: finish one app's actual first content frame (P0)
Dooz has NavHost materialization and draw replay but remains budget-bound. Do not reopen the rejected AbortFlowException-swallowing theory. Instrument one end-to-end frame with phase timings for recomposition, measure, layout, draw recording, raster, budget check and present. Compare dooz, Guandan and one unrelated Compose APK. Select a shared divergence only if two apps reproduce it. Acceptance: completed first content frame within existing budget, stable app-owned face three times, no regression on two Compose/View controls.

### 5 — F-145: screenshot/window ownership across multiple Activities (P1)
Create a fixture with Activity A→B, dialog/overlay, back, finish and second launch. Trace window token/root ownership, z-order, visibility, dimensions and screenshot selection. Distinguish wrong window captured from app never drawing. Fix top-of-stack selection and lifecycle cleanup generically. Validate three navigation/settings apps plus a dialog/overlay; assert expected root IDs and app-owned pixels before/after back.

### 6 — F-NEW-192: draw/z-order audit residue (P1, only if trace confirms visible defect)
Inspect exact open registry rows and current render-node/view ordering; distinguish sibling order, elevation/Z, clipping, invalidation and capture order. Build overlapping opaque/translucent sibling and nested-clipping fixtures with known pixel answers, including invalidate/remove/re-add. Patch only the first proven generic divergence; test five View/Canvas APKs and preserve goldens. If no current visible failure exists, reject with evidence.

### 7 — F-NEW-214: logging/trace data must not change runtime behavior
Audit whether diagnostics mutate state, consume iterators, alter exceptions, retain stale mutable objects, or materially change timing. Compare trace-off/on on identical app faces and state. Test null, large, repeated, exception-bearing and concurrent logger inputs. Keep output bounded and redact sensitive content. Fix only a reproduced instrumentation-boundary bug; report overhead and prove deterministic faces remain identical.

### 8 — Canvas field-less argument diagnostics: resolve exact residuals, not the already-correct general unwrap law
Current report names arg_fields=(none) for solitaire ×17, dooz ×1, Telegram ×1, plus unresolved RectF in addRoundRect and Path in clipPath. Add typed argument diagnostics for null, wrapper-without-fields, wrong type and resolved object; include wrapper type/ID and requested member. Determine whether each field-less argument is a legitimate opaque object or a bridge defect. Add positive/negative fixtures for drawBitmap, RectF, Path and nested wrappers. Patch only proven mapping and validate five affected/unrelated Canvas APKs.

### 9 — AndroidGraphics object graph after native initialization (P1 native-game frontier)
CONT-86 says tower3d still lacks AndroidGraphics object-graph fields after F-NEW-387/389. Trace every field read/write from constructor through onSurfaceCreated, onSurfaceChanged and onDrawFrame; classify each as Android contract, libGDX expectation or unsupported API. Add a narrow fixture and negative tests for truly absent fields. Implement generic framework contracts and test tower3d plus two native-engine APKs. If GLSL is blocked, report prerequisite progress, not a visible game win.

### 10 — End-to-end swipe input after F-NEW-390 (P1)
F-NEW-390 fixed callback receiver/argument shift, but CONT-86 notes e2 still carries DOWN coordinates and the 4-float payload lacks current coordinates. Trace MotionEvent construction → dispatchTouchEvent → GestureDetector → listener → game state. Add current coordinates only if source confirms they are lost, preserving old callers. Test down/move/up/cancel, pointer ID, coordinates, dx/dy, velocity and a no-gesture negative control. Validate g2048 and two unrelated games/apps with state-change proof and repeatability.

## Execution policy
Start with tracks 1–5; do not start an unbounded renderer rewrite. Tracks 6–10 require evidence gates and should be batched by common code path. Re-run at least five distinct APKs, target ten when feasible, deduplicated by APK SHA-256; prioritize x86/x86_64 and classify ABI prerequisites separately. Every track gets ROOT_CAUSED_FIXED, CONFIRMED_NOT_FIXED, REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE or BLOCKED. Report changed app outcomes, exact first-missing-stage movement, full commit/binary SHA-256, commands, fixture counts, repeatability and regressions. Preserve wall A/B, goldens, negatives, reinstall, c72priv, MG-310, MG-150, s82 validator, corpus runner and graphics trace. No package-specific code, fake shader success, longer per-app timeout, golden edits that hide drift, or counting instrumentation-only progress as app compatibility. DexSQL remains LIMITED ADOPT only for DEX callsite/caller lookup per CONT-82.

## Success gate
At least three root fixes or newly completed contracts measurably improve unrelated real APKs with no regression. If backend or Compose constraints block visible wins, report exact blocker and the smallest executable next experiment. This is a code-and-runtime wave, not another plan-only report.
