# CONT-88 — REAL APP EXECUTION CAMPAIGN: close open game/app frontiers; Telegram UI becomes a first-class end-to-end target; WhatsApp-family parity

This is a coordinated implementation directive inside master Issue #364. It explicitly reconciles existing open work instead of creating another disconnected issue. Read the current bodies/evidence of #16, #354, #355, #356–#363, #366, #371–#384, and relevant open per-app EXEC issues before coding. In particular: #381 is the evidence-integrity audit; #383 defines the base-first graphical baseline; #384 defines execution families; #375/#376 contain prior completion/root census; #366 identifies installed apps that still go blank. Update/close existing tickets only when current-head evidence proves their criterion; do not create duplicate roots or reset old evidence.

## Non-negotiable outcome
Move real apps from NOT_LOADING/CRASH/WHITE/DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY/PARTIAL to REAL_APP_CONTENT and verified interaction. Telegram and WhatsApp-family targets are named flagship acceptance targets, but **no Telegram-/WhatsApp-package branches, hand-painted mock screens, forced screenshots, or app-specific fake framework returns** are allowed. Every fix must be a generic Android/runtime law that benefits other apps. Source availability helps explain expected behavior; it does not replace Android framework, native libraries, lifecycle, storage, graphics, network, or UI execution contracts.

## Phase 0 — CURRENT-HEAD TRUTH and existing issue reconciliation
1. Fetch origin/main; record full HEAD, clean/dirty tree, binary SHA-256, root-registry SHA/count, corpus manifest SHA and toolchain versions.
2. Read the complete open-item tables and current comments in #381, #383, #384, #375, #376, #366 and #16. Enumerate all open per-app game/app tickets in the registry. Build a single deduplicated ledger keyed by package + APK SHA-256 + root ID.
3. For every open target, capture current status: NOT_LOADED, CRASH_BEFORE_UI, LIFECYCLE_ONLY, VIEWTREE_ONLY, MEASURED_OFFSCREEN, DRAW_OPS_NO_PIXELS, PIXELS_DEFAULT_ONLY, REAL_APP_CONTENT, INTERACTIVE. Preserve previous evidence; mark stale claims rather than overwriting history.
4. Pick the highest-fan-out shared roots from actual first divergences. Do not spend the wave just producing more census or prose: at least four implementation/fix attempts must reach code+fixture or be explicitly blocked by a proven dependency boundary.

## Phase 1 — TELEGRAM: a large, explicit end-to-end workstream
Primary targets:
- Official Telegram Android target from #16 and the S117→S119/S121/S122-era records in #356–#363; revalidate exact APK identity/hash and current source revision.
- Forkgram Classic anchor from #355 as the same-lineage differential/control, not as proof official Telegram is complete.
- Preserve the existing 190-goal roadmap in #363; update goal statuses with evidence instead of inventing a second roadmap.

### T1. Explain the actual remaining UI gap from source + current runtime trace
Build a screen-by-screen execution graph for official Telegram and Forkgram: Application startup → LoginActivity → phone entry → next/SMS state where reproducible → main Dialogs list → search → opening a chat → message composer/keyboard boundary → profile/settings/navigation. For each screen, trace actual DEX calls, Activity/Fragment lifecycle, View tree, layout bounds, Canvas operations, image/text resources, state transitions and final pixels. Identify the earliest missing contract per screen. Full Telegram source should be used to inspect callers, expected view/layout/fragment behavior and resource usage; do not merely say “source exists” or port a whole class.

### T2. Make screenshots prove complete UI rather than one successful face
Use the existing deterministic Telegram runner and data-root isolation. Capture at least login, dialogs list, chat view and one settings/profile view if reachable. Each must have APK hash, runtime commit, run log/trace hash, screenshot SHA-256, pixel/color/non-background metrics, app-owned draw provenance and element/bounds assertions. Repeat every claimed screen three times. Distinguish genuine app pixels from debug placeholders, splash, host overlays and blank backgrounds.

### T3. Fix layout and window ownership across screens
Audit current remnants from #359/#360 and open #145/window-surface frontier: parent-specific default LayoutParams, Space/minimum sizes, MeasureSpec, measured dimensions, scroll containers, nested ViewGroup clipping, status/navigation insets, decor/root selection, action bar and fragment container. Trace why any view is outside viewport, zero-sized, covered or attached to the wrong root. Add AOSP-contract fixtures; fix only first proven shared divergence. Test official Telegram, Forkgram and three unrelated View/RecyclerView apps.

### T4. RecyclerView, adapters, stable IDs and empty/loading states
Trace adapter attachment, item count, view-type creation, bind/recycle, layout manager, scroll offsets, child attachment and item decoration. For the Dialogs list, prove whether expected row data and child views exist, have bounds, issue draw calls and produce visible pixels. Add minimal fixtures for empty list, 1/20 rows, scrolling, notifyDataSetChanged/item insert/remove and recycling. Do not substitute a fake Telegram dialog row.

### T5. Text/font/emoji/complex shaping and text measurement
Compare AOSP/Android behavior for TextView, StaticLayout, Spannable spans, baseline/font metrics, line breaks, bidi/RTL, emoji/surrogate pairs, typeface fallback, ellipsize, maxLines and custom text views. Use upstream source and minimal pixel fixtures, then check Telegram labels, dialog titles/previews and message text. Do not change fonts/goldens merely to make screenshots look closer; document the expected contract and raster bounds.

### T6. Drawable, vector, WebP, animated/media placeholders and image lifetime
Audit resource ID resolution, theme tint/state, bounds, intrinsic dimensions, density, mutate/state, Bitmap decode/config, WebP/animated image frame selection, clipping and alpha. Telegram UI includes icons/avatar/media placeholders; identify which missing elements are resource lookup vs drawing vs absent app data. Test shared fixtures and at least three non-Telegram apps. Do not make fake colored blocks count as media.

### T7. Fragment/back-stack/navigation and screen state
Trace fragment transaction enqueue/commit/execute timing, attach/create/view-created/start/resume, saved state, nested fragments, back stack, transition and root invalidation. Verify the Dialogs → chat → Back path preserves correct screen and state. Add deterministic generic fragment fixtures; do not bypass the real Fragment implementation with package-specific shortcuts.

### T8. Telegram app-data/native boundaries and startup latency
Trace SQLite/JNI, SharedPreferences, files/assets, coroutine/executor work, pending exceptions, network-dependent initialization and loading placeholders. Separate genuinely missing backend/network state from UI engine failures. Use bounded deterministic local fixtures where live network/auth is unavailable; do not claim a live authenticated chat if no credentials/service exist. If startup remains slow, profile phase durations rather than extending timeout without explanation.

### T9. Input-driven Telegram progress
Use real input sequences, not direct mutation of app state. Verify phone field focus/text entry, Next, SMS field when available, search, list item tap, chat composer focus and Back. For each step capture the event path, listener/DEX method, state delta and next screen pixels. If remote authentication is impossible, mark the exact boundary and still complete all offline/reachable screens.

### T10. Current-head regression of every Telegram law
Re-run the official APK and Forkgram on current HEAD after each root fix. Re-run three known good controls (Bouncy, Ballbreak, Breakout or current canonical controls) plus the smallest relevant root fixtures. Keep historical claims in #356–#363, but label old HEAD-only results HISTORICAL until current HEAD reproduces them. Never use rc=0 or zero uncaught exceptions as visual proof.

## Phase 2 — WHATSAPP + messaging-family execution, without pretending WhatsApp source is public
### W1. Establish the real target
Search the current corpus for a WhatsApp APK and pin its package/version/SHA-256/ABI/source. If no legally available target artifact is present, explicitly report NOT_AVAILABLE and use an available open-source messaging control (Signal or another real app already in corpus); do not invent a WhatsApp APK or claim source access that does not exist. Keep official WhatsApp as a desired acceptance target only when an exact artifact is available.

### W2. Messaging shared path
Use Telegram/Forkgram/Signal/WhatsApp if available to cluster shared failures: Activity/Fragment lifecycle, RecyclerView, text/image, resource/theme, SQLite/preferences/files, async/background callbacks, input/focus/keyboard and window/insets. Find the first common missing base primitive, implement the generic fix, and run at least three messaging-family targets where artifacts permit.

### W3. Message-like list and conversation fixture
Create a small independent test APK (or reuse an existing open-source app) with a list of messages, avatar images, timestamps, multiline text, scrolling, composer and stateful send button. This is a diagnostic fixture, not a substitute for real Telegram/WhatsApp. Use it to validate shared UI contracts deterministically, then verify the same root on real apps.

## Phase 3 — close game and application white-screen frontiers
Use #366's five known white apps as the initial cohort (Fossify Clock, BlockBlast, Asteroids Revenge, Space Vertex, Memory) and cross-reference current per-app issues and #354's game ledger. Re-run at current HEAD; historical white classifications are not assumed current. Add at least five other open game/app tickets selected by fan-out and ABI suitability.

For every target:
- verify exact APK identity and ABI; x86/x86_64 are main runtime targets, ARM-only is PREREQUISITE_MISMATCH unless ARM support is specifically in scope;
- record the first missing stage from install → DEX execution → lifecycle → tree → measure/layout → draw calls → raster → final window → input/state;
- cluster at least two unrelated apps on a shared root before claiming high fan-out;
- implement a minimal generic fix plus positive and negative fixtures;
- verify app-owned pixels and, for games, actual game-state change after input;
- run three times for any final VERIFIED claim.

Priority families: View/RecyclerView, Fragment/navigation, resource/theme/text, native/JNI boundary, Canvas/RenderNode, Surface/EGL/GLES where actual APKs require it, event/input, app-private storage and async scheduling. Do not reopen a previously rejected theory without new first-divergence evidence.

## Phase 4 — source reuse and upstream law validation
For each root, inspect MiniAndroid source first, then the authoritative AOSP/AndroidX/library source matching the exact relevant version where available. Reuse small correct algorithms/contracts, not entire frameworks or package-specific code. External tools/repositories (including non-English issues) are discovery sources only; local trace + fixture + real APK is proof. Record exact upstream commit/version and license when copying implementation.

## Delivery checklist and stop rules
- At least 8 distinct real APKs re-executed this wave (Telegram official and Forkgram count as distinct APK hashes; include at least five other apps/games); target 12 if artifacts and runtime budget permit.
- At least four root-fix attempts reach a source change + fixture + real-app validation, or are explicitly BLOCKED with the smallest concrete experiment proving the blocker.
- Telegram: at least four real screens attempted, three-run evidence for every screen claimed complete, and a precise residual screen-by-screen list.
- Messaging family: exact WhatsApp artifact availability verdict; at least one generic messaging UI contract tested on a real open-source target.
- Games: at least three distinct game APKs re-run, and every claimed success requires app-owned pixels; interactive success requires state delta.
- Report before/after counts for NOT_LOADED, WHITE/DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY, REAL_APP_CONTENT and INTERACTIVE using distinct APK SHA-256 denominators. Include screenshot and trace hashes, command lines, full HEAD, binary SHA-256, root registry diff and regressions.
- Preserve all existing gates: wall A/B, goldens, negatives, reinstall, c72priv/privacy, MG-310, MG-150, s82 validator, CONT-81 corpus/harness, graphics trace and all current Telegram controls.
- Do not close #16, #355, #356–#363, #366, #381 or per-app EXEC tickets merely because this wave ran. Close/update only when each issue's own acceptance is met at current HEAD; otherwise link the exact remaining blocker and evidence.

## Required final report
One compact scoreboard with (a) open issues reconciled and duplicates/closures, (b) fixes by root and changed source files, (c) official Telegram screen-by-screen outcomes, (d) WhatsApp artifact/source verdict, (e) each white app's first missing stage before/after, (f) newly real-content and newly interactive APK counts, (g) regression results, and (h) top three next blockers. Separate IMPLEMENTED, FIXTURE_TESTED, REAL_APK_OBSERVED and VISUALLY_VERIFIED. No plan-only completion.

## Success criterion
At least three generic fixes measurably advance unrelated real APKs with no regression, and official Telegram gains a demonstrably more complete reachable UI journey (not just another login screenshot). If a live service or missing native backend blocks a screen, state that boundary precisely while still closing all reachable offline/UI contracts.

CONT-89 — TELEGRAM UI FORENSIC COMPLETION (screen-by-screen, source + current-head proof)

# CONT-89 — TELEGRAM UI FORENSIC COMPLETION (subtrack of #364 / CONT-88)

This is the focused Telegram delivery track, not a new root registry. Read #16 and #355–#363, especially the official-vs-Forkgram attribution, the 190-goal roadmap, S121 render laws and known window/layout frontiers. Revalidate on current origin/main.

## Exact question
The source is available, yet why is the complete UI not rendered? Answer per screen and per missing semantic contract—not “Android compatibility is incomplete.” The app's Java/Kotlin source does not implement Android framework behavior on MiniAndroid; its DEX calls still depend on the runtime's Activity/Window/View/Fragment/RecyclerView/Canvas/resource/font/animation/native contracts. Source must be used to follow call sites and expected state, not treated as proof the runtime can execute every dependency.

## Required screen ladder
1. Official Telegram login/phone screen.
2. Login Next transition; SMS/code screen if reachable under deterministic offline inputs.
3. Main Dialogs screen, including real list rows only if real app data exists.
4. Search state.
5. Open a chat/conversation if local/reachable state permits.
6. Profile/settings or another reachable secondary page.
7. Back/navigation restoration.

For each screen record exact APK SHA-256, current commit and binary SHA-256, Activity/Fragment, window/root IDs, lifecycle, view tree, bounds/clip/visibility, text/image/drawable sources, Canvas op census, raster/present status, screenshot hash/pixel metrics, input event + state delta, and first missing transition. Three runs for each screen claimed verified. No mock rows, package-name branches, fake data or host-painted overlays.

## Root-cause sequence
A. Compare source call path against actual DEX trace and shadow dispatch; list methods that ran, methods that were intercepted, and methods that returned fabricated/default values.
B. For offscreen/missing elements, trace the exact parent and LayoutParams/MeasureSpec/insets/scroll/clip chain.
C. For present tree but missing pixels, trace onDraw/dispatchDraw → Canvas ops → raster → final window. Distinguish intentional transparent custom view from capture gap.
D. For missing list/chat contents, trace adapter count, bind/recycle, item children, actual backing data and async callback delivery. Do not synthesize data.
E. For missing images/icons/emoji/text, separate resource lookup, drawable state/bounds, font shaping, bitmap decode and paint failures.
F. For missing navigation, trace Fragment transactions, lifecycle and back stack, not a forced screen switch.

## Code delivery
Pick the first current-head generic divergence that affects at least two independent Telegram/Forkgram/other-app paths. Add a minimal fixture, implement one contract-correct fix, test five related APKs where available, and re-run the Telegram screen ladder. Update #363 goal states rather than creating a second roadmap. Historical screen evidence remains historical until re-run at current HEAD.

## Acceptance
At least one additional reachable Telegram screen or state transition becomes real and repeatable; all existing login/Dialog screen claims are revalidated honestly; three-run screenshot/trace evidence is attached; no regression in Bouncy/Ballbreak/Breakout and existing gates. If auth/network/native dependency blocks a screen, identify that exact boundary and finish all reachable UI work instead.

# CONT-93 — TEN-GAME MOVEMENT + ACTION + STRATEGY/FARM + 3D EXECUTION MATRIX

This is the final game-focused complement to CONT-88/90 inside master Issue #364. It is NOT a request to merely launch ten APKs or create ten new per-game hacks. Use existing EXEC/game issues and current corpus first; preserve their identities and update them with current-head evidence. Prioritize movement, animation, input/state, stage progression and actual graphics.

## Goal
Test ten distinct game targets spanning:
- 2D real-time motion / physics;
- arcade action / shooter / runner;
- puzzle with animated board/state changes;
- platform/strategy/sandbox progression;
- farming/management-style simulation if a legally usable APK exists;
- Age-of-Empires-like real-time strategy and a true 3D rendering path.

Do not claim all genres are represented if a usable APK is unavailable. If farm/RTS/3D target is not in the corpus, source an open-source/legal x86/x86_64-compatible Android APK, pin exact version and SHA-256, add it to the corpus, and report prerequisite mismatch separately. Do not use ARM-only APKs as evidence of a runtime failure.

## Ten targets (existing corpus/issue anchors first)
1. **Bouncy — com.dozingcatsoftware.bouncy — #21**: 2D physics; move beyond menu/click proof to actual multi-round game-loop state evolution, moving ball/physics and repeatable frame changes.
2. **Mouse Pounce — com.dozingcatsoftware.mouse_pounce — #101**: real-time motion/reaction game; source/pin a valid APK, verify animation cadence, touch-to-state transition and score/round progression.
3. **Asteroids Revenge — com.game.asteroids_revenge — #109 / #366**: 2D action/shooter candidate; establish APK/ABI first, then verify moving sprites, continuous frame loop, projectile/enemy collision or a real action-state change.
4. **FafaRunner — com.chenyifaer.fafarunner — #115**: runner/movement; verify scrolling/world motion, obstacle/state change, touch input and score/game-over path where reachable.
5. **BrickBlast — com.mostafa.brickblast — #106**: arcade action/ball physics; verify paddle/ball movement, collision, score and restart—not a static menu.
6. **TripleMatch — com.sidhant.triplematch — #122**: board/puzzle state; verify actual tile swap/selection, board mutation, match/score or equivalent game-state delta, and animation where the app implements it.
7. **Privacy Friendly Memory — org.secuso.privacyfriendlymemory — #98**: turn-based visual/input control; verify card flip, matched/unmatched state and round completion. This gives a contrasting low-complexity control for event/animation semantics.
8. **Breakout 71 / HTML5 Breakout — existing #94 and evidence chain #353**: WebView/JS game loop; verify that JS timers/RAF, Canvas2D, input and repeated gameplay frames remain functional. Keep this separately classified as the WebView family, not native Android Canvas.
9. **One 3D-capable target — prefer a current corpus APK that actually uses EGL/OpenGL ES (inspect manifest/native libraries/runtime trace; candidates include the existing Space Vertex target in #366 if its exact APK proves this)**: test context creation, shader compile/link, buffers/textures, draw calls, swap/present, depth/blend and moving camera/object. Do not label a 2D canvas game as 3D. If no eligible 3D APK exists, source one with reproducible legal provenance or mark 3D target BLOCKED with the smallest proven prerequisite.
10. **One strategy / farm-management target**: first search the corpus for a real farm/management/RTS APK. If none is usable, source one legal open-source Android strategy/farming title. Prefer a small 2D RTS/factory/farm-management control with visible world, units/entities, selection, placement and progression; if an Age-of-Empires-like APK is selected, record its exact ABI and whether it uses native GLES/Vulkan, Java Canvas or another renderer. Do not claim Age of Empires itself is tested unless that exact artifact is present and pinned. Farming and Age-of-Empires-like strategy are related genre goals but are not interchangeable; report which one the chosen target actually represents.

## Phase 0 — truth and target acquisition
- Read #354, #366, #21, #98, #101, #106, #109, #115, #122, #353 and all linked/current per-app execution records.
- Check the current APK corpus before downloading anything. For each target record package, title, versionCode/versionName, min/target API if available, ABI/native libs, APK SHA-256, source URL/license, and existing issue.
- Re-fetch only artifacts proven corrupt/missing; do not silently replace a corpus APK with a different version.
- Pin current origin/main commit, binary SHA-256 and test harness version. Historical statuses remain HISTORICAL until rerun.

## Phase 1 — common gameplay ladder for every target
For each APK:
1. INSTALL/IDENTITY_OK; ABI compatible.
2. DEX/native initialization reaches actual game screen.
3. First meaningful app-owned pixels (not splash/default background/placeholder).
4. Continuous animation/game loop over a measured time window.
5. Real input through the normal event path.
6. State delta in real game objects/model (not just screenshot hash).
7. Result visible in the next frame: moved entity, changed board, score, collision, selected unit, placed item, etc.
8. Stage/round/game-over/restart when the game exposes it.
9. Three-run reproducibility for any VERIFIED status.

For movement games capture at least 10 frames over time and report frame hashes plus a simple motion metric (changed pixels/bounding-box/object centroid where available). A changing screenshot alone is insufficient if it is flicker or nondeterministic noise. For input, prove event → real listener/DEX method → state delta → visible pixels.

## Phase 2 — cross-family generic graphics/input roots
Trace the first divergence, then cluster at least two distinct APKs per proposed generic fix:
- frame pump, animation invalidation, Choreographer/Handler scheduling and elapsed-time semantics;
- touch coordinates, pointer/action semantics, pressed/move/release, hit-testing and focus;
- Canvas transforms, clipping, alpha, paths, bitmaps, text and draw order;
- RenderNode recording/replay and stale-op accumulation;
- Surface/EGL/GLES context, shader compiler/backend, buffer/texture upload, framebuffer and final present for real 3D target;
- asset/resource loading and density;
- audio/timer/collision only if actual trace identifies it as a blocker.
Use upstream/AOSP/engine source as reference, but local fixture + real APK behavior is the proof. Never add package-name conditions or force an animation/screenshot.

## Phase 3 — farm/RTS and 3D are first-class, not optional wording
- For the farm/strategy target, test world/map drawing, entity updates, selection/placement, camera/scroll/zoom and persistent progression as actually implemented by that APK.
- For the 3D target, prove an actual GLES/EGL path and app-owned rendered geometry. Log context/config, shader compile/link logs, GL errors, buffer/texture sizes, draw counts, swap/present and screenshot provenance. Distinguish Java UI around a 3D game from the actual 3D scene.
- If current runtime lacks shader compilation, test practical CPU/headless options (Mesa llvmpipe or an already-supported software GLES backend) only if available in the project/toolchain; do not claim shader support because GL entry points return success. A shader compile/link + rendered scene is required.
- Age of Empires-like target: verify that the selected APK really contains RTS-like entities/selection/pathing; do not use a turn-based puzzle as a substitute. Farm management and RTS should be separately labelled in the report.

## Phase 4 — measurable result and issue reconciliation
For all ten, return one table:
target | issue | APK SHA | ABI | before state | first missing stage | root ID | source files changed | fixture | after state | movement/state proof | screenshot/trace hashes | 3-run result | regression.
Report counts with distinct APK SHA denominators: NOT_LOADED, WHITE/DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY, REAL_APP_CONTENT, ANIMATED_CONTENT, INTERACTIVE, VERIFIED_GAMEPLAY. Do not combine static render with animated gameplay.

At least four generic fix attempts must reach source + fixture + real-game test, or be explicitly BLOCKED with a concrete dependency proof. At least three unrelated game APKs must improve through generic changes without regressions. Preserve all gates (wall A/B, goldens, negatives, reinstall, privacy, MG-310, MG-150, s82 validator and current graphics/Telegram controls). Update existing issues; do not duplicate them or close them because a menu appears.

## Definition of done
- At least 8/10 targets have a current-head launch verdict; target 10/10 if valid artifacts exist.
- At least 6/10 have real app-owned content; at least 4/10 demonstrate input→state delta→visible result, otherwise state exactly which generic blocker prevents it.
- At least one moving 2D action/physics game proves multiple real frames; one strategy/farm target proves its actual progression interaction; one true 3D target proves rendered geometry and motion.
- If a target is missing/unavailable/ARM-only/proprietary-service blocked, label it honestly and do not count it as runtime failure or success.
- No completion based only on rc=0, no uncaught exception, ViewTree, draw-op count or static screenshot.

## ۲. Track 1 (F-NEW-395 P0) — اجرا شد؛ حکم دو-بخشیِ صادقانه

### بخش الف — ادعای ثبت‌شده‌ی «handler-match» با شواهد **رد می‌شود**
- **decode واقعی** (androguard، `scripts/cont87_decode_luu.py`، APK `org.andstatus.game2048_47` sha16 `2d6707624623fe88`): try در `Luu;.<clinit>` فقط code-units **7..12** را می‌پوشاند (ناحیه‌ی `getMethod("onSpinWait")`)؛ فراخوانی `forName` در unit **2** است — **بیرون از try**. پس verdict موتور («uncaught» در pc=2) طبق semantics درستِ DEX بود؛ ریشه‌ی ثبت‌شده در CONT-86 یک decode اشتباه بود.
- **fixture** `com.probe.clinit1` (sha16 `d0de76b819c1f725`) ثابت کرد catch-all درون‌فریمی برای **هر دو** منبع raise درست dispatch می‌شود: CNFE→`deferred handler @0x14`، ARITH→`@0x15`.
- روی دستگاه واقعی هیچ‌وقت به این پوشش وابسته نبود — forName برای کلاس framework هرگز throw نمی‌کند (پل F-NEW-394 همان قانون را در CONT-86 برگرداند).

### بخش ب — نقص صداقتی ثبت‌شده **تأیید و رفع شد** (fixture قبل از فیکس fail، بعد از فیکس pass)
| ردیف fixture | قبل (`d22b36be55764348`) | بعد (`caa24290aad77ca9`) | قانون |
|---|---|---|---|
| C87-CC (forName در catch درون-clinit) | caught:CNFE ✅ | caught:CNFE ✅ (بدون تغییر) | catch درون‌فریمی |
| C87-AC (10/0 در catch درون-clinit) | caught:AE ✅ | caught:AE ✅ (بدون تغییر) | همان قانون |
| C87-UT (استفاده‌ی اول از کلاسِ throw-کرده) | AE خام به caller | AE خام به caller ✅ (رفتار app-visible حفظ شد) | استثنای اصلی در handler پوشاننده |
| C87-UT2 (استفاده‌ی دوم) | **s=42 — clinit دوباره اجرا شد!** | **NoClassDefFoundError** ✅ | JVMS 5.5 erroneous |
| [CLASS_INIT] ClinitThrow | **result=OK با وجود throw** | **result=FAILED + F-NEW-215 erroneous** ✅ | صداقت state machine |

**ریشه‌ی واقعی:** `halted_on_return_` هم برای return معمولی ست می‌شود هم برای unwind — بنابراین finalize گزارش `COMPLETED_SUCCESS` برای clinitِ unwound می‌داد؛ کلاس poison-marked INITIALIZED می‌ماند و استثنای خام به invoke-site «بعدها» teleport می‌شد (همان CNFE داخل MyMainActivity.onCreate).

**فیکس (عمومی، ۳ سایت، بدون شرط package):**
1. finalize: unwind ⇒ `COMPLETED_PARTIAL` + `halt_reason="unwind <type>"`؛ SUCCESS مارکرهای stale را پاک می‌کند.
2. سایت فراخوانی clinit مارکر را می‌خواند و کلاس را به مسیر ثبت‌شده‌ی F-NEW-215 می‌برد.
3. گارد `clinit_exc_already_in_flight()` در ۶ سایت active-use (sget/sget-object/sput/sput-object/new-instance/forName) — استفاده‌ی trigger-کننده استثنای خود clinit را تحویل می‌گیرد؛ استفاده‌های بعدی NCDFE.

**null صادقانه‌ی میانی:** تلاش اول فیکس double-raise داد (NCDFE در pc پیش‌رونده از try بیرون زد و boot کشته شد — `clinit_post2.stderr` rc=1). با گارد in-flight جایگزین شد؛ ثبت شد، پنهان نه.

## ۲. اجرای تلگرام در HEAD فعلی — کشف ریشه

اجرا (`run/cont94/tg_official_1`): LaunchActivity → RESUMED، درخت view عمیق `org/telegram/ui` — اما framebuffer فقط **۱۸۸/۲,۰۷۳,۶۰۰ پیکسل غیرسفید** (رندر نیست — صادقانه). ۳۱ استثنای uncaught؛ زنجیره‌ی NPE در `ActionBar/s2.checkSystemBarColors` و `onBecomeFullyVisible` ×۳.

**decode واقعی** (androguard؛ `scripts/cont94_decode_*.py`):
- `s2.checkSystemBarColors`: `getParentActivity()` → `instanceof LaunchActivity` → check-cast → `H(Z Z Z)V`
- `LaunchActivity.H` فیلد `p0` را می‌خواند و `ActionBarLayout.w()` را روی آن صدا می‌زند
- `z0(I)V`: `iget y0` → `e4.setInternalNavigationBarColor`

**پروب‌های موتور** (`MINIANDROID_F141_DIAG` + پروب جدید `[C94-SINGLETON]`):
- گیرنده‌ی invoke در H برابر **NULL** بود؛ `this` برابر **obj#7307**
- `[C94-SINGLETON] MISS 'Lorg/telegram/ui/LaunchActivity;' (no cache entry) → allocated obj#7307`
- `[U0113-ACTIVITY] activity heap object #694` — فعالیت واقعی که onCreate را اجرا کرد
- `[R414-INIT-DEFAULT]` ثابت کرد حتی state اولیه‌ی فیلدها روی #7307 غایب بود

## ۳. ریشه (F-NEW-396) — تایید با شواهد

**مسیر launch DEX-0 فعالیت واقعی را می‌سازد (`#694`) اما هرگز `api_singletons_[cls.name]` را ذخیره نمی‌کرد** (فقط مسیرهای multi-DEX و legacy-scan ذخیره می‌کردند). سه سایت intercept والدِ `getParentActivity()` همه با `get_or_create_singleton("Lorg/telegram/ui/LaunchActivity;")` پاسخ می‌دادند — cache MISS → **ساخت یک شیء تازه‌ی مقدار-اولیه-نشده از کلاس هاردکد** (کلاس درست، نمونه غلط). `instanceof` اپ رد می‌شد؟ نه — رد می‌گذشت! سپس `H(Z Z Z)V` روی شیء خالی اجرا شد → `p0`=null → `ActionBarLayout.w()` روی گیرنده null → NPE ×۳ → سه APP-BOUNDARY unwind → ساخت UI لاگین کشته شد → قاب سفید.

## ۴. فیکس — عمومی، ۴ سایت، بدون هیچ شرط package

1. **قانون هویت**: مسیر launch DEX-0 حالا `api_singletons_[cls.name]` را ذخیره می‌کند (همان قانون دو مسیر دیگر) — ردیف `[C94-SINGLETON] LAUNCH-STORE`
2. **قانون والد زنده**: intercept اصلی `getParentActivity` اکنون فعالیت زنده را از `ActivityShadow::current_activity_id()` برمی‌گرداند (کلاس از heap حل می‌شود)؛ پنجره‌ی قبل-از-اتچ = null (قرارداد AOSP)
3. + 4. دو قلوی bridge و shadow-dispatch: همان قانون

**residual نام‌گذاری‌شده (صداقت):** اتصال آرایه‌ی `doneButtonVisible[0..9]` روی گیرنده یک پچ APP-SPECIFIC از era EXP-071 است (اسم فیلد هاردکد تلگرام) — این موج دست‌نخورده ماند تا رفتار ثبت‌شده‌ی flow لاگین حفظ شود؛ عمومی‌سازی fixture-first به‌عنوان follow-up ثبت شد.
